params.body:
Three follow-ups to #856, #857 and #858.

## 1. The model finding names the right pull request
`bevindingen/2026-09-29-een-model-leek-gekozen.md` said `opgelost_in: #856`; the fix landed in #857.

## 2. Transport runs between garages
Decided on 2026-09-29 and recorded in the open point: transport in Stocklist is between garages, not to a customer. The code was right (R S4-10.3: delivery to an own location with the delivery function; R S4-10.17: a bought vehicle goes from the seller's location to the buyer's), the text around it was not.

- The introduction of S4-10 no longer speaks of delivering "bij een klant"; it says the delivery address is always an own delivery location of the requesting dealer, never a customer's address.
- Open point `transport-leveradres-enkel-eigen-locaties` is closed (`status: opgelost`, `beslist: Shane`, `opgelost: 2026-09-29`, `opgelost_in: #859`) with the decision written under it.
- The demo dataset wrote a transport straight into the table with the customer's address, something the form cannot do. The Yaris transport now goes to an own branch of the demo dealer (`Filiaal Gent`, a delivery location), with `delivery_id` set.
- The secondary question in that open point is still a real question after the decision: an own vehicle that carries its own pick-up location (`pick_up_location_id`) is picked up at the dealer address, while a bought vehicle uses the seller's pick-up location and the indicative price reads the vehicle's location. It is now its own open point, `eigen-wagen-ophalen-op-zijn-ophaallocatie` (for Ilse).

## 3. Transport screens write numbers like the rest of the platform
Left over from #858, which avoided these files because #856 touched them.

- Mileage: "Kilometerstand 31000" becomes "31 000 km" in the request and detail modals and in the transport mails (`Custom::formatNumber`, as #858 did elsewhere).
- Money: "€204,00" becomes "€ 204,00" / "€ 21 900,00" in the detail modal and the overview, the app's standard `€ {{ Custom::formatNumber(...) }}`.
- The first column of the transport overview (and the same line in the office mail) showed the transport's number under the Nederland Mobiel label `dealer.id` ("Unieke key"). It now has its own key `transport.number`: Nummer / Numéro / Number / Nummer. The Nederland Mobiel label is unchanged.
- Finding `transport-cijfers-en-kolomnaam` (opgelost in this PR).

## Tests
- `ScreenWordingTest`: three new tests (detail modal mileage and price, mileage in three transport mails, the transport number label and the untouched Nederland Mobiel label).
- Full suite locally: 2378 tests green. Rules tests, `QualityRatchetTest`, `TransportChainTest`, `TransportMailTest`, `DemoScreensCommandTest` green. PHPStan: no errors. No new PHP files, so no Pint run.
params.title: Transport is between garages; transport screens write numbers like the rest of the platform
